resources.string: Stock Shizuku Detected

Having stock Shizuku installed alongside 白い熊 雫 can cause permission conflicts and app crashes. To ensure 白い熊 雫 functions correctly, please uninstall or disable the stock Shizuku app.

You can do this via:
1. Settings -> Apps -> Shizuku -> Disable/Uninstall
2. Below buttons (if 白い熊 雫 service is running)
3. ADB: adb shell pm disable-user --user 0 moe.shizuku.privileged.api
Disable Stock
Uninstall Stock
